bracket--noun.def: A punctuation mark, or a group within a range.
bracket--noun.ex: Put the date in a bracket.

decomposition--noun.def: The natural process of breaking down into parts.

clog--verb.def: To block a pipe or a passage.

qualification--noun.def: An official certificate, or a skill you need for a job.

repertoire--noun.def: All the pieces a performer can play or sing.

mastery--noun.def: Complete skill or control in a subject.
mastery--noun.ex: His mastery of the language impressed us.

tremor--noun.def: A small earthquake, or a shaking movement.

preferable--adj.def: Better or more suitable than something else.

simultaneous--adj.def: Happening at exactly the same time.

gradual--adj.def: Happening slowly over a long period.

ineffective--adj.def: Not producing the result you want.

syllable--noun.def: A unit of sound in a word.

verbally--adv.def: In spoken words rather than in writing.

crease--noun.def: A line made in cloth or paper by folding.
crease--noun.ex: There is a crease in the map.

splatter--noun.def: A mark made by liquid thrown onto a surface.
splatter--noun.ex: A splatter of paint marked the floor.

contaminate--verb.def: To make something dirty or dangerous by adding a substance.

discriminate--verb.def: To treat a group unfairly, or to see a difference.

legislative--adj.def: Relating to the making of laws.

carpool--noun.def: An arrangement where people share one car to travel.
carpool--noun.ex: They started a carpool to work.
carpool--noun.exTr: İşe gitmek için araç paylaşımı başlattılar.

tightrope--noun.def: A rope high in the air that an acrobat walks on.

strait--noun.def: A narrow passage of sea between two areas of land.

exclaim--verb.def: To say something suddenly and loudly from feeling.

contradictory--adj.def: Saying the opposite of something else.

artificially--adv.def: In a way made by people rather than by nature.

athletics--noun.def: Sports such as running, jumping and throwing.

dropout--noun.def: A person who leaves school before finishing.

adorn--verb.def: To decorate something, in formal English.

mogul--noun.def: A very rich and powerful businessman.
mogul--noun.ex: A media mogul bought the paper.
mogul--noun.exTr: Gazeteyi bir medya patronu satın aldı.

breezy--adj.def: With a pleasant wind, or cheerful and relaxed.

outback--noun.def: The remote dry inland part of Australia.
outback--noun.ex: Few people live in the outback.

laborer--noun.def: A worker who does hard physical work.

mover--noun.def: A person or company that moves furniture for people.

coincide--verb.def: To happen at the same time as something else.
coincide--verb.ex: The visit coincided with the festival.

bustle--verb.def: To move around quickly and busily.

legislature--noun.def: The body of people who make a country's laws.

humbug--noun.def: Dishonest talk meant to deceive people.

recollect--verb.def: To remember something from the past.

quotation--noun.def: Words taken from a text, or a stated price for work.

revolve--verb.def: To turn in a circle around a centre.
revolve--verb.ex: The earth revolves around the sun.

expressive--adj.exTr: İfade gücü yüksek bir yüzü var.

broaden--verb.def: To make something wider or more general.

reflective--adj.def: Sending back light, or thinking deeply.
reflective--adj.ex: Wear a reflective strip at night.

metric--adj.def: Using the system of metres and kilograms.

interactive--adj.def: Allowing information to pass both ways.

falter--verb.def: To lose strength or confidence and hesitate.
falter--verb.ex: His voice faltered at the end.

iceman--noun.def: A man who delivered ice before fridges existed.
iceman--noun.ex: The iceman came twice a week.

overturn--verb.def: To turn something over, or to cancel a decision.

hatching--noun.def: The process of young birds breaking out of eggs.

bathhouse--noun.def: A building with baths where people wash together.

circuitry--noun.def: The system of electrical circuits in a device.

bestseller--noun.def: A book that sells in very large numbers.

picturesque--adj.def: Pretty in an old-fashioned and charming way.
picturesque--adj.ex: It is a picturesque fishing village.

leisurely--adv.def: In a slow and relaxed way.
leisurely--adv.ex: They walked leisurely along the shore.

pave--verb.def: To cover a road or a path with a hard surface.
pave--verb.ex: They paved the courtyard last year.

caption--noun.def: The words printed under a picture.

unjustly--adv.def: In a way that is not fair.

deduce--verb.def: To reach a conclusion from the facts you have.
deduce--verb.ex: We deduced the cause from the marks.

anchorage--noun.def: A safe place where ships can anchor.
anchorage--noun.ex: The bay is a good anchorage.

signify--verb.def: To be a sign of something.

debit--noun.def: An amount taken out of a bank account.

debit--verb.def: To take money out of an account.

competence--noun.def: The ability to do something well.

classification--noun.def: The act of putting things into groups.
classification--noun.ex: The classification is based on size.

cascade--noun.def: A small steep waterfall, or a flow of something.
cascade--noun.ex: A cascade fell down the rocks.

regrettably--adv.def: Used to say that you are sorry about a fact.

unsuitable--adj.def: Not right for a purpose or an occasion.
unsuitable--adj.ex: The film is unsuitable for children.

inflate--verb.def: To fill something with air, or to raise prices unfairly.
inflate--verb.ex: Inflate the tyres before you go.

villager--noun.def: A person who lives in a village.

detach--verb.def: To separate one part from another.
detach--verb.ex: Detach the lower form and keep it.

impractical--adj.def: Not sensible or not possible in real life.

irritation--noun.def: Slight anger, or soreness of the skin.

alphabetical--adj.def: Arranged in the order of the alphabet.
alphabetical--adj.ex: Put the names in alphabetical order.

cyclist--noun.def: A person who rides a bicycle.
cyclist--noun.ex: A cyclist waited at the light.

economist--noun.def: A person who studies how money and trade work.

dandelion--noun.def: A wild plant with a yellow flower and seeds that blow away.
dandelion--noun.ex: A dandelion grew in the crack.
